field_list_note: supersedes the M0 field list in NLP_PIPELINE_REFACTOR_PLAN.md (which duplicated thematic_frame); stance_target included as construct declaration; text columns intentionally excluded (joined via post_id)

golden_files.determinism: re-running the documented export procedure on the same source dataset + register yields a byte-identical file

population.definition: rows of master_triangulation_repaired.csv whose post_id is NOT excluded by docs/DATA_EXCLUSION_REGISTER.csv (dataset=master_repaired); sorted by post_id ascending (string)

P1_existing_predictions.comparison_rule: M1-M2: outputs must equal golden exactly (same code semantics). M3: batched-vs-single-loop determinism on these records; fresh-model output is NOT regressed against historical labels (differences expected and must be reported, never hidden)
P1_existing_predictions.definition: sentiment_model present - HISTORICAL predictions preserved from legacy runs (provenance-tagged, not verified fresh inference)

P2_requires_rerun.comparison_rule: new-inference population; regression not applicable; outputs recorded as fresh_inference with model_version
P2_requires_rerun.definition: inference_source == requires_rerun (X only); no golden label exists

P3_non_english.comparison_rule: EN sentiment model guard must SKIP these; routing verification only; any prediction requires an approved route (translation/multilingual) - PENDING TEAM APPROVAL

P4_und.comparison_rule: same as P3; fastText-LID evaluation may reclassify some - gate documented in refactor plan section 5.2
P4_und.definition: language == und (short texts below 40-char LID threshold)

provenance_notes: All 1,407 existing sentiment predictions are HISTORICAL: X labels recovered deterministically from archive/legacy_pipelines/7_hasil4_x (legacy rule passthrough relation); YouTube/News labels copied from legacy per-platform outputs (10_hasil5_yt, 13_hasil_news).

Legacy runs used the model identifier cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest (per legacy script code) but recorded NO execution metadata (transformers version, revision, date); the X annotations additionally come from a partially unshipped pipeline. Historical != verified fresh inference.

The language guard was NOT enforced historically: id and und rows carry historical predictions produced by running the English-only model on untranslated text (evidence: label distributions below in preflight report).
stance_rule_* columns are the experimental keyword layer, verbatim-preserved; thematic_frame/framing_evidence are the repaired lexicon outputs.
legacy_final_label column = pre-repair label, provenance only, never to be analyzed.

repo.code_state: production+test code identical to commit (verified via git status -- src tests)
